doc.summary: Adds a new shaped recipe based on the input objects.
doc.text:
Adds a new shaped recipe based on the input objects. The input objects must be built like this:

(A sub list means that one of its elements can be used.)

  • Optional: A Identifier that serves as the recipe id.
  • Optional: A RecipeCategory. Defaults to RecipeCategory#MISC
  • Optional: A single ICondition or an array of IConditions as conditions for the recipe.
    • An ItemLike for the output, optionally followed by an Integer for the amount.
    • An ItemStackTemplate which is the result of the crafting recipe.
  • One or more Strings that form the pattern lines of the recipe.
  • For every non-space character used in the pattern: the Character itself followed by the ingredient identifier that defines that key.

An ingredient identifier is one of the following:
  • An ItemLike
  • A TagKeyltItemgt
  • An Ingredient
  • A list of the ones above.

doc.summary: Adds a new shapeless recipe based on the input objects.
doc.text:
Adds a new shapeless recipe based on the input objects. The input objects must be built like this:

(A sub list means that one of its elements can be used.)

  • Optional: A Identifier that serves as the recipe id.
  • Optional: A RecipeCategory. Defaults to RecipeCategory#MISC
  • Optional: A single ICondition or an array of IConditions as conditions for the recipe.
    • An ItemLike for the output, optionally followed by an Integer for the amount.
    • An ItemStackTemplate which is the result of the crafting recipe.
  • One or more ingredient identifiers that make up the recipe inputs.
  • Optional: One or more IConditions as conditions for the recipe.

An ingredient identifier is one of the following:
  • An ItemLike
  • A TagKeyltItemgt
  • An Ingredient
  • A list of the ones above.
